description: Prune block-1 pre-attention LayerNorm biases in nearest-neutral order
proposal: Family: scalar pruning. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 25 prior macro-attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0059 at 2,118 parameters/99.05%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0116, whose block-0 pre-attention bias coordinate 3 scored 97.30% at 1,671 parameters. Hypothesis: sensitivity at block 0 does not imply the recurrent block-1 pre-attention site is equally sensitive; its nearest remaining bias, coordinate 13 at +0.0110794, was not part of the earlier pruning boundary and may be neutral. The helper orders the 12 eligible biases by current absolute magnitude, fixes one to zero per micro-trial, and the official runner alone accepts or rolls back. Stop on first scored discard or error, no coordinate, 12 micro-trials, or 18 wall-clock minutes. This is more informative than the nearest scale alternative because the bias perturbation is smaller and directly tests whether the block-0 failure is site-specific.
summary: The block-1 pre-attention bias policy evaluated its least-magnitude remaining coordinate, index 13 at +0.0110794. The 1,671-parameter candidate scored 98.58% and was discarded. Outcomes: 0 accepts, 1 scored nonqualification, 0 errors; frontier remained 1,672/99.01%. Compute used one checkpoint migration and official verification in about 1m22s. Stop reason: first scored discard before the 12-trial/18-minute cap.
